# Bandar list format: one service per line; "[group @environment]" starts a group, "[]" ends it.
[shop @production]
shop-postgresql = kubectl --context prod -n shop port-forward svc/ok-shop-psql 25432:5432
shop-redis = kubectl --context prod -n shop port-forward svc/flaky-shop-redis 25379:6379
sessions-redis-cluster = kubectl --context prod -n shop port-forward svc/ok-sessions-redis-cluster 25390:6379
events-kafka = kubectl --context prod -n shop port-forward svc/ok-events-kafka 25392:9092
chat-api = kubectl --context prod -n shop port-forward svc/ok-chat-api 25394:8080

[shop-stage @staging]
shop-stage-postgresql = kubectl --context stage -n shop-stage port-forward svc/ok-stage-psql 25433:5432
shop-stage-redis = kubectl --context stage -n shop-stage port-forward svc/auth-stage-redis 25380:6379

[]
reports-postgresql = kubectl port-forward svc/missing-reports 25436:5432
